stateOwner: one coordinator owns the headless A/V generation, latest selected source frame, shared renderer, pending rendered frame, HWND surface, render serial, present serial, cancellation admission, and close receipt
threadContract: all synchronous play, seek, tick, render, resize, present, cancel, and close work runs on one background presentation executor and never on the Qt UI thread

invariants.singleClock: each admitted scheduler tick calls the headless A/V tick exactly once and reuses its target timeline frame without separate clock math
invariants.sourceOwnership: the latest selected source frame remains cached until replacement, cancellation, or close so a surface retry or resize cannot consume a second media frame
invariants.coalescing: an unchanged source PTS, target timeline frame, settings, and surface does not rerender or call Present
invariants.retry: occluded and busy presentation retain one rendered frame and retry at most once on a later scheduler tick without polling
invariants.resize: resize marks cached content dirty but does not consume media or render synchronously on the caller's resize request
invariants.failure: render or terminal surface failure stops the matching playback generation, releases cached frame ownership before its receipt, and returns an explicit terminal result; a terminal surface refuses playback and resize until a new session owns a new device
invariants.cancellation: close requests the admitted operation stop source before waiting for serialized ownership; cancellation is rechecked before render and Present, and no work is admitted after close
invariants.settings: the boundary accepts one immutable project-compiled static video layer, passes its exact-CFR source start to playback, requires a new playback generation for source-mapping changes, and rebuilds every timeline frame through the shared project RenderPlan compiler before rendering
invariants.transport: pause and resume preserve the generation, compiled settings, selected source frame, rendered-frame cache, and visible surface; paused ticks do not reach the A/V clock
invariants.seek: seek validates the exact current generation and the end-exclusive compiled clip interval, maps the requested timeline frame through the existing static layer source offset with checked arithmetic, replaces playback with one newer generation, and renders and presents its exact first frame without clearing the old surface first
invariants.clipBoundary: the first target frame at or beyond the compiled clip interval stops source playback, preserves the last valid frame, and completes without rendering inactive content

excluded: visible pixel and interactive cadence evidence
